constraints_details.constraints_layer_description: A4D Storage and distribution to residential

decision_conditions: <p>Prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved,&nbsp; a cycle plan shall be submitted to the local planning authority for written approval showing details of the layout, foundation, stand type and spacing for 6 no. cycles to be parked / stored at the site for future employees.&nbsp; The approved cycle plan shall subsequently be implemented in full prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved and thereafter shall be kept in good condition in perpetuity.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>REASON:&nbsp; In the interests of the promotion of sustainable modes of transport across the borough in accordance with Hackney Borough Council's adopted parking standards and TfL's London Cycle Design Standards.&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p><br></p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall not proceed beyond superstructure level until full details of the proposed external materials, including render, window, door, roof and rainwater goods materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.</p><p>The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved which shall be implemented in full prior to the first occupation/use of the development and retained in perpetuity.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: To ensure a satisfactory form of development and in the interests of the visual amenity of the host building and the area.<br></p><p><br></p>

<p>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, as amended, or any order modifying or replacing that order whether in whole or in part, the extension hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose falling within Use Class E(g) [for—</p><p>(i) an office to carry out any operational or administrative functions,</p><p>(ii) the research and development of products or processes, or</p><p>(iii) any industrial process,</p><p>being a use, which can be carried out in any residential area without detriment to the amenity of that area by reason of noise, vibration, smell, fumes, smoke, soot, ash, dust or grit.] of Part A of Schedule 2 to that Order and for no other purpose within Use Class E of that Order.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: Other general commercial uses within Use Class E are considered to be inappropriate for the site for residential amenity and transport reasons.</p><p><br></p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall not proceed beyond superstructure level until details for the provision of bee bricks and swift boxes to be incorporated into the fabric of the development have been submitted to the local planning authority for written approval.&nbsp; The approved measures shall subsequently be implemented prior to first occupation/use of the development and retained in perpetuity.</p><p>REASON:&nbsp; In the interests of enhancing the biodiversity value of the site.&nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
description: Erection of first floor extension and refurbishment of existing building with external wall insulation and double-glazed windows; erection of external staircase; provision of new employment unit.
